operations.name: Saw Cut Round Blanks
operations.setup_note: Cut Ø32 aluminium round bar into 14 mm blanks, retaining allowance for facing, gripping, and parting. Process the 100-piece order as one saw batch.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Front, OD, Recess, Thread and Part Off
operations.setup_note: Grip the saw-cut blank in a step collet or bored soft jaws and establish the opening-side face as the axial process reference. Machine the concentric OD, blind recess, thread, specified edge chamfer, and then part off.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Back Face to Thickness
operations.setup_note: Locate the parted component in a thread-protecting split collet or threaded pot chuck and seat it against the completed opening-side face. Face the parted side to the confirmed overall thickness and web condition.

operations.name: VMC Drill and Chamfer Hole Pattern
operations.setup_note: Hold the plug in a thread-protecting circular nest with the hole-entry face upward, locating concentrically from the turned axis and axially from a finished face. Spot and drill all four PCD holes before producing their entry chamfers.

operations.name: Manual Deburr
operations.setup_note: Support the thin plug on a non-marring bench fixture and remove burrs from the through-hole exits, thread ends, recess edge, and faced surfaces without rounding functional geometry.

operations.name: Clean and Degrease for Conversion Coating
operations.setup_note: Rack and clean the completed parts to remove cutting fluids and debris before chromate conversion coating. The 100-piece order may be processed as one rack batch if line capacity permits.

operations.name: Mask External Threads
operations.setup_note: Mask the external threads before chemical treatment unless the customer confirms that the chromate coating is required on the threaded surface.

operations.name: Yellow Chromate Conversion Coating
operations.setup_note: Rack-process the complete order with yellow Type II, Class 1A chromate conversion coating per the drawing specification. Maintain coverage in the recess and through holes.

operations.name: Remove Masking
operations.setup_note: Remove thread masking after the conversion coating has dried and verify that no masking residue or chemical entrapment remains.

operations.name: Final Dimensional and Coating Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect overall thickness, recess geometry, hole pattern, external thread with a ring gauge, edge condition, and conversion-coating appearance and coverage after thermal stabilization.

clarifications.question: What is the correct external thread designation, given that 1.25-20UN-2A has a nominal 31.75 mm major diameter but F02 and the part envelope specify Ø28 mm?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat Ø28 mm as governing for stock and routing, but do not release thread machining until a corrected thread designation is supplied.

clarifications.question: Is the required residual web thickness 1.0 mm, or is it 2.0 mm as implied by the 4.6 mm overall thickness and 2.6 mm recess depth?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the directly dimensioned 4.6 mm overall thickness and 2.6 mm recess depth, resulting in a 2.0 mm residual web.

clarifications.question: Should the external thread receive the yellow chromate conversion coating, or must it be masked?
clarifications.suggested_default: Mask the external thread in accordance with the standard surface-treatment route.

assumptions.text: The overall part-body depiction is not treated as a separate machinable feature; route coverage is assigned to F02 through F06.
The spindle axis is treated as X based on the section view, despite the conflicting isometric orientation note.
Standard Ø32 mm round bar is used because no forged or custom near-net blank is specified and the quantity of 100 does not independently justify forming.
Tailstock support is omitted because the finished length-to-diameter ratio is far below 4:1.
A separate thread-relief groove is omitted because the graph shows no shoulder or relief feature and the thread occupies the short external profile.
Pilot drilling, peck drilling, reaming, tapping, and precision hole boring are omitted for F04 because the holes are short Ø3 mm clearance-type through holes with only the general ±0.1 mm tolerance.
Milling datum faces, profiles, pockets, and slots are omitted because the component is rotational and its finished faces and recess are produced on the lathe before VMC hole making.
Turning and milling final inspections are consolidated into one final inspection after coating, with normal operator checks occurring during machining.

A coating cure or hydrogen-embrittlement bake is omitted because the specified process is chromate conversion on 6061 aluminium rather than paint, powder coating, anodizing, or plated high-strength steel.
The controlled operation type plate is used as the closest available schema representation for chemical chromate conversion coating.
F06 instance count two is interpreted as the two section-view intersections of one circumferential 0.5 × 45 degree chamfer on the right-face outer edge.
